description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM upgrade workflow. It handles the upgrade wizard interface, including loading steps, managing user permissions, handling upgrade scripts, displaying upgrade history, and rendering the upgrade page interface. It coordinates various upgrade phases like system check, upload, preflight, commit, and end, using PHP logic and Smarty templates.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: Manages the history of applied upgrades, providing functions to retrieve installed upgrade records from the database.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty templating engine instance used for rendering the upgrade wizard interface.

methods.name: getUWDirs
methods.description: Returns the directories used for upgrade files and temporary files.

methods.name: prepSystemForUpgrade
methods.description: Prepares the system environment for the upgrade process.

methods.name: set_upgrade_vars
methods.description: Initializes necessary variables for the upgrade process.

methods.name: initialize_session_vars
methods.description: Restores or initializes session variables related to upgrade progress.

methods.name: get_upgrade_progress
methods.description: Fetches the current upgrade step if an upgrade was interrupted and needs to be resumed.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for specified modules.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Clears cached data to ensure fresh configurations.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon for a given upgrade manifest type.

methods.name: getChecklist
methods.description: Generates the upgrade checklist for the interface.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Creates the page title for the module interface.
